entity_ref.description: Typed ID of a later entity (hyp_..., exp_...).
entity_ref.title: Entity Ref

position.description: Zero-based index in the destination column; omitted means append.
position.title: Position

project_id.description: If given, the card must belong to this project.
project_id.title: Project Id

version.description: Current version of the card (optimistic locking).
version.title: Version

CodeProvenance.description:
The exact code of a run.

``ref`` mode: ``sha`` is fixed when the run is created and the run executes an export of
that commit, so it is clean by construction. ``working_tree`` mode: the state is captured
when the run starts; ``sha`` is then the commit under the working tree and ``diff_sha256``
identifies the uncommitted changes that were executed with it.

captured_at.description: When the executed state was fixed.
captured_at.title: Captured At

diff_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the executed uncommitted changes (a binary patch).
diff_sha256.title: Diff Sha256

dirty.description: Executed with uncommitted changes. Null until the run starts.
dirty.title: Dirty

sha.description: Full commit SHA of the executed code.
sha.title: Sha

submitted_with_dirty_working_tree.description: The project directory had uncommitted changes when the run was created. In ref mode they are not part of the run.
submitted_with_dirty_working_tree.title: Submitted With Dirty Working Tree

untracked.description: Untracked files that were part of the executed tree.
untracked.title: Untracked

untracked_archived.description: Whether the untracked files were small enough to be stored.
untracked_archived.title: Untracked Archived

CodeProvenance.title: CodeProvenance

CodeSpec.description:
Which code a run executes.

``ref``: an exact commit, resolved when the run is created and executed from an export of
that commit, never from the working tree. ``working_tree``: the project directory as it is
when the run starts, uncommitted changes included; an explicit choice because it is only
reproducible through the recorded diff.
CodeSpec.title: CodeSpec

variables.description: Environment of the run. Values of names that look like secrets are redacted.
variables.title: Variables

EpistemicStatus.description: What the evidence says about a hypothesis. Independent of any workflow status.
EpistemicStatus.title: EpistemicStatus

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. NOT_FOUND.
code.title: Code

ErrorEnvelope.description: The one JSON shape of every non-2xx response.
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

run_id.description: The run this event belongs to, if any.
run_id.title: Run Id

seq.description: Monotonic ledger position; the replay cursor.
seq.title: Seq

ExecutableRecord.description: The program file that ``argv[0]`` resolved to.

path.description: Null when it could not be resolved.
path.title: Path

ExecutableRecord.title: ExecutableRecord

build.description: Commands run in the code directory before the program starts.
build.title: Build

command.description: Argument vector, never a shell line. {name} is replaced by a parameter.
command.title: Command

environment_probes.description: Commands whose output is recorded as environment provenance.
environment_probes.title: Environment Probes

inherit_env.description: Names passed through from the supervisor's environment.
inherit_env.title: Inherit Env

ExecutionTrust.description:
Allow NumericOS to execute commands in the project directory.

The caller repeats the exact path: trust is given to a directory, not to a project name.
ExecutionTrust.title: ExecutionTrust

hypothesis_id.description: The hypothesis this experiment tests, if any (not a baseline).
hypothesis_id.title: Hypothesis Id

protocol_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical protocol; runs record it.
protocol_digest.title: Protocol Digest

hypothesis_id.description: Explicit null unlinks the hypothesis; an absent field keeps it.
hypothesis_id.title: Hypothesis Id

protocol.description: Replaceable only while the experiment has no runs.

controls.description: Parameters that are identical in every run.
controls.title: Controls

independent_variables.description: What varies between runs, with the values the experiment will use.
independent_variables.title: Independent Variables

FailureClass.description: Why a run did not end normally. The classes call for different reactions.
FailureClass.title: FailureClass

GuardrailRule.description: An explicit numeric limit on a metric. No threshold is ever assumed by NumericOS.
GuardrailRule.title: GuardrailRule

non_finite.description: What to do when a metric is NaN or infinite. It is always recorded.
non_finite.title: Non Finite

python.description: The interpreter of the NumericOS supervisor, not of the run.
python.title: Python

claim.description: What is asserted, so that it can turn out wrong.
claim.title: Claim

falsification.description: Outcomes that would contradict the claim.
falsification.title: Falsification

epistemic_status.description: What the evidence says so far. It changes only through recorded decisions.

InputSpec.description: A file the run reads; its checksum is recorded and, if given, enforced.

base.description: code: inside the executed code; project: under the project root.
base.title: Base

InputSpec.title: InputSpec

Limits.description: Resource envelope of one run, enforced by the supervisor.

grace_seconds.description: Between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when a run is stopped.
grace_seconds.title: Grace Seconds

Limits.title: Limits

MetricSpec.description: A quantity the experiment measures, with its unit and who measures it.

sampled_by.description: instrumentation: the program emits numericos.metric.v1 records; parser: extracted from its output by a parser of this contract; supervisor: measured by the supervisor (wall_time, cpu_time, max_rss).
sampled_by.title: Sampled By

MetricSpec.title: MetricSpec

ParserSpec.description:
Extracts metrics from the program's output lines (observability level L1).

``pattern`` is a Python regular expression. Every named group except ``step`` is a metric
of that name; the optional group ``step`` is the sample's step.
ParserSpec.title: ParserSpec

ProbeRecord.description: Output of one environment probe command, kept as an artifact.

exit_code.description: Null when the command could not be run.
exit_code.title: Exit Code

ProbeRecord.title: ProbeRecord

is_demo.description: Marks demo data so the GUI can label it.
is_demo.title: Is Demo

root_path.description: Absolute path of the research code. Stored as a reference, never opened.
root_path.title: Root Path

execution_trusted_at.description: When executing commands in root_path was explicitly allowed; null if not.
execution_trusted_at.title: Execution Trusted At

root_path.description: Explicit null clears the path; an absent field keeps it.
root_path.title: Root Path

version.description: Current version of the project (optimistic locking).
version.title: Version

code_ref.description: The commit this run executes (branch, tag or SHA), instead of the protocol's default ref. This is how a candidate and a baseline differ under one protocol.
code_ref.title: Code Ref

parameters.description: One declared value for every independent variable of the experiment.
parameters.title: Parameters

argv.description: The exact argument vector of the program.
argv.title: Argv

code.description: The exact code this run executes.

environment.description: Host, program file, probes and variables. Null until the run starts.

inputs.description: Checksums of the declared inputs. Null until the run starts.
inputs.title: Inputs

parameters.description: The complete assignment: controls and the chosen independent values.
parameters.title: Parameters

reproduces_run_id.description: The run this one repeats with the same code, parameters and seed.
reproduces_run_id.title: Reproduces Run Id

status.description: Operational state. 'succeeded' is a normal process end, not a valid result.

RunRecord.description: Everything needed to repeat a run: the run, with its provenance, and its protocol.
RunRecord.title: RunRecord

RunStatus.description:
Operational state of one execution. ``succeeded`` means the process ended normally;
it says nothing about the scientific validity of what it computed.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus
